history.summary: Freehold 1BR (603sqft — a generously sized one-bedder) at $1,657 PSF in D12 Balestier, priced slightly below the $1,683 URA median, with steady 2.9%/yr resale-only appreciation on 21 txns. Just-below-$1M freehold near Novena's medical belt, but 1.13km from MRT and a modest growth rate.
history.rating_rationale: A safe, low-conviction freehold hold: 603sqft is a comfortable 1BR (better resale than a true shoebox), PSF is marginally below median ($1,657 vs $1,683), and 2.9%/yr on 21 txns is reliable. But 1.13km to Novena MRT is a real walkability drag, growth is below the city-fringe baseline, and a 1BR has a niche owner-occupier pool. Steady rental near the Novena medical hub, no real upside catalyst.
catalysts: Novena medical hub (hospitals) drives healthcare-worker rental demand
Generous 603sqft layout aids resale vs shoeboxes
